steps.label: Cache HIT test
steps.error: Cache miss when hit was expected. First generatedAt=1777847704582, second generatedAt=1777847707334.

observations.rootCause: Cache cluster wasn't AVAILABLE yet when test ran (no polling at this iteration); also requests sent Cache-Control: no-cache which APIGW respects → bypassed cache.

fixApplied: Two changes: (1) Added waitForCacheClusterReady() polling — APIGateway.getStage every 15s up to 6 min until cacheClusterStatus === 'AVAILABLE'; called BEFORE step 4 so the MISS response actually populates the cache. (2) Removed 'Cache-Control: no-cache' header from getEndpoint() — APIGW honors it and bypasses the cache cluster, defeating the test.
